text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 54

INSOLVENCY ORDER, 2016 (S 112016) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 111) and (2) of the Insolvency Order, 2016, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the date of commencement of the Insolvency (Winding Up) Rules, 2018 as the date on which section 246(c) (reference to Twelfth Schedule to the Companies Act (Chapter 39)) of that Order shall commence. Dated this 9th. day of Muharram, 1440 Hijriah corresponding to the 19th. day of September, 2018. DATO SERI SETIA DR. AWANG HAJI MOHD. AMIN LIEW

BIN ABDULLAH Minister of Finance 11, Brunei Darussalam.
